pages.text: Storage Housing in Refined Storage 2 serves as the foundational shell for creating $(l:storage_disks)Storage Disks$() and $(l:fluid_storage_disks)Fluid Storage Disks$() with improved durability and reliability. It is an empty casing that can be combined with a $(l:storage_parts)Storage Part$() or $(l:fluid_storage_parts)Fluid Storage Part$() to form a complete disk. This flexibility allows players to upgrade or change their storage configurations as needed, now with better performance and enhanced data integrity.
